summary: Validated the 3-item backlog end-to-end: (1) Admin Feed Moderation Screen, (2) Apple Link/Unlink from Profile, (3) Multi-day Events (end_date + overlap search). Backend: 21/21 new pytest tests green + 42/42 existing regression tests (events, feed_reports, apple_auth) green — 63/63 total = 100%. Frontend: signed in as Erin (admin), /admin/reports renders correctly with all documented testIDs (admin-reports-back, admin-reports-tab-{open|actioned|resolved|dismissed|all}) and each report card exposes admin-report-{open-user|delete|resolve|dismiss|action}-{report_id}. Confirmed Erin Profile shows profile-moderation-cta and profile-sign-in-methods; Apple row is correctly hidden on web (native module unavailable). Confirmed Jamin (instructor-only, non-admin) hitting /admin/reports is redirected back to /(tabs) and his Profile has NO moderation CTA but sign-in-methods panel is still present. Non-admin (fresh user) receives 403 on /api/admin/* while /api/users/{me} still works.

react_native_issues.issue: Console error observed on web preview: 'Unexpected text node:       . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' Whitespace text is being emitted between children of a <View>. Not tied to the new screens (fired from index/tabs render), but E1 should track it down. Likely a stray literal or template string in one of the root layouts.

action_items: Investigate 'Unexpected text node' React warning surfaced repeatedly in web console — likely a raw whitespace/newline inside a <View> in a root layout (age-gate/tab layout). Non-blocking for the backlog features but should be cleaned up.

Multi-day event UI (EventCard collapse to 'Fri, Sep 14 – 15', event detail hero, event-form-end-date validation) was not exhaustively exercised via Playwright because instructor event-form flow is deep behind several taps; backend end_date persistence, PATCH, and overlap search are all fully covered by pytest. Please self-test the form / card rendering by creating a multi-day event as Erin.
critical_code_review_comments: backend: /admin/feed/reports PATCH correctly stores resolution_note trimmed and truncated to 600 chars.
backend: /admin/feed/events DELETE keeps report rows for audit trail with event_exists=false — verified.
backend: /auth/apple/unlink refuses (400) when only Apple + synthetic email + no password — verified.
backend: /events/search $expr overlap filter correctly surfaces multi-day events on any day in their span while keeping single-day events out of non-matching queries.
frontend: /admin/reports properly guards with useEffect redirect to /(tabs) when !user.is_admin — verified against Jamin.
frontend: SignInMethodsSection correctly hides the Apple row on web (Platform.OS !== 'ios') with no crash.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_backlog_* users, TEST Multiday events, and moderation reports were created and best-effort cleaned up. A couple of throw-away events / reports may remain due to teardown ordering — all name-prefixed TEST_ / 'TEST '.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The auth screen has NO auth-email-input/auth-password-input/auth-submit-button testIDs — use bounding-box mouse.click below password field to submit. Age-gate has testID 'age-gate-adult'. Erin admin queue has 18+ reports across statuses, use the tab-'all' chip to see everything. /admin/reports report_id format is 'reporter_id:event_id' and the Ionicons-wrapped Pressables ARE clickable directly via [data-testid='admin-report-{action}-{report_id}'] — no coordinate fallback needed.
rca_of_issue: N/A — all backlog features validated green.
